name: mcp-stock-analyst
title: MCP Stock Analyst
description: Remote MCP server for stock data: real-time quotes, fuzzy search (Chinese / pinyin / code) and historical K-lines for China A-shares, Hong Kong and US markets. Free upstream data source, no API key required.

inputSchema.title: MCP Stock Analyst
inputSchema.description: This Actor is a remote MCP server and does not take a manual input. Connect your MCP client to the Actor's standby endpoint (see README) and call the tools from there.
